client-alert-without-client-type.json.rule: a client's alert is checked against its client type, which the producer passes (fails closed; CONVENTIONS v1.1 L84)

client-without-client-id.json.rule: a client or account-manager notice names its client (F-46)

details-vendor-unlisted.json.rule: a vendor named without its route is one the registry lists (ADR-0051; note 11)

fallback-unknown-reason.json.rule: a fallback notice's reason is from the registry reason list (ADR-0021; Q11)

fallthrough-to-webhook.json.rule: the fall-through is an n8n channel (ADR-0067 L27)

government-poster-rule.json.rule: a government client receives the keyword-level rule types only (alert-evaluator §5.3 C L65; ADR-0048)

government-scope-platform.json.rule: a government client's alert names no platform (alert-evaluator §6.2 L102)

government-scope-source.json.rule: a government client's alert names no source (alert-evaluator §6.2 L102)

government-subject-platform.json.rule: a government client's alert names no platform (F-50)

government-subject-source.json.rule: a government client's alert names no source (alert-evaluator §6.2 L102; F-50)

open-details.json.rule: details is one of three typed branches, never an open object (Q11)

ops-with-client-id.json.rule: an ops notice names no client (F-46)

route-fallback-without-platform.json.rule: a route's fallback notice names the platform and route (ADR-0021)

source-fallback-without-source-id.json.rule: a source's fallback notice names the source (ADR-0021)

subject-vendor-unlisted.json.rule: a vendor is the registry's for its route (ADR-0051; note 11)

unknown-channel.json.rule: channel is email, telegram, slack or webhook (F-23; O-11)

unknown-severity.json.rule: severity is info, warning or high (F-48)

volume-spike-without-ratio.json.rule: a volume spike reports its ratio (alert-evaluator §6.2 L86-L99)

with-author-ref.json.rule: an alert carries no author_ref (alert-evaluator.md L65; F-51)

with-handle.json.rule: an alert carries no handle (alert-evaluator.md L128; F-51)

with-item-text.json.rule: an alert carries no item text (alert-evaluator.md L128; F-51)

with-provenance.json.rule: an n8n notice carries producer only (F-51)
